capabilities: create sermons from three-point and narrative templates with title and passage reference
search the sermon library by passage, topic, series, form, and preparation status
read the current note page by page with navigation, outline, and text-size controls
install four editable sermon, study, and reflection templates without overwriting existing ones
extras: Interface and bundled templates are Korean only. No Bible text database is bundled; scripture must be entered or pasted manually. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in templates or workflow for preparing, archiving, and reading out sermon manuscripts.
summary: Sermon-writing workspace that creates three-point and narrative sermon notes from templates, with a searchable sermon library and page-by-page manuscript reading.
